subject: Banking
title: Apple Pay and Tokenization
description: A short lesson to help you apply Apple Pay and Tokenization.

hook.text: Apple Pay never shares your real card number with the merchant. A unique token replaces it for every transaction.

buildup.text: When you add a card to Apple Pay, your bank creates a Device Account Number stored in the phone's secure chip.

discovery.text: Each payment generates a one-time dynamic security code. Even if a hacker intercepts it, the token cannot be reused.

twist.text: Apple charges banks 0.15% per transaction for this service.

climax.text: Apple became a payment company without being a bank. It charges rent on the most secure checkout experience.

punchline.text: Your real card number is never shared. Apple charges banks for the safety.

quiz.question: How does Apple Pay protect card information?
options: Replacing the real card number with a unique token for each transaction
